name: merged-dev-runtime
description: Credential-free Tier-P source installation from one clean merged dev commit, using the real non-editable installer and installed command.

config.CR_SOURCE_COMMIT: optional exact commit reachable from fetched dev; defaults to its captured tip

stages.title: acquire and pin clean merged dev source
materialize source and run the real installer
verify completed source-qualified runtime and installed command
invoke the runtime with the source checkout unavailable
verify the source-qualified build is actually serving
